entities.summary: Margaret Ann Dix was a British-born Guatemalan botanist and taxonomist. In 1972, she founded the Center for Environmental Studies and Biodiversity at the Universidad del Valle de Guatemala in Guatemala City. Her research focused on Guatemalan orchids and orchid taxonomy, as well as plant behavior and limnology.
